title: person-vault-carrier: case shape (v0.2)
description: Pins the device-local vault-bound person-identity carrier AAD (aad_person_vault_carrier: role 'person-vault-carrier-blob', binding vault_id || person_id under the v0.2 AAD prefix). The carrier's KEK is DeriveSubkey_v0_2(root_key, 'person-vault-carrier'), pinned by the hkdf-sha256/v0.2 family; this family pins the AAD framing. Cross-implementation contract (myne-md/myne#792, decisions/protocol/0622).
